applyTo: "src/static/**/*.{html,css,js}"

# Frontend Instructions

## Scope
- Apply these rules for files under src/static.
- Keep changes focused on the requested feature or fix.

## HTML
- Use semantic structure and meaningful labels.
- Keep markup simple and easy to scan.
- Ensure interactive elements are keyboard accessible.

## CSS
- Reuse existing selectors and variables when possible.
- Prefer responsive layouts that work on mobile and desktop.
- Avoid broad resets and high-specificity selectors unless required.

## JavaScript
- Keep DOM logic clear and defensive.
- Prefer small functions with explicit naming.
- Handle API and network errors with visible user feedback.

## Consistency
- Match existing UI patterns unless a redesign is explicitly requested.
- Avoid unrelated refactors while implementing feature work.
